summary_en: 44,429,000 shares (6.96% of outstanding), ¥114.8B limit, ¥2,585/share, ToSTNeT-3 block on June 2, 2026 at 08:45 JST. Part of ¥130B program (June 1–Sept 30, 2026). Six major shareholders (Effissimo, MS&AD, Tokio Marine, KHI, Norinchukin, Sompo Japan) confirmed participation proportional to May 29 holdings.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-market transaction
translation_en_brief: Kawasaki Kisen filed notice on June 1, 2026 of a single-day off-market buyback block via ToSTNeT-3. The company will acquire up to 44,429,000 shares (6.96% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥114.8 billion at ¥2,585 per share on June 2, 2026 at 08:45 JST. This block is part of a broader authorization approved by the board on May 29, 2026, permitting acquisition of up to 44,429,000 shares for ¥130 billion over the period June 1–September 30, 2026 using both ToSTNeT-3 and open-market purchases. The company confirmed that six major shareholders—Effissimo Capital Management, MS&AD Insurance Group, Tokio Marine & Nichido, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Norinchukin, and Sompo Japan—intend to participate in the block proportionally to their May 29 holdings. Any shares not acquired in the June 2 block will be pursued through subsequent open-market purchases within the full authorization window.
